'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=梅丽莎}} is a deceased [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}}. After completing Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens her reverberation can be found in the [[Lost Beyond]].

It is unknown what is Melissa and [[Triss]] relationship, but it can be assured they are family. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}} 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Melissa''' Triiiiiiisss.

:'''Melissa:''' Where did Triss run off to... That child's{{sic}} always darting about. If she could just stay where I could see her. 
:'''Melissa:''' Phrolova and I were meant to go to the city... Maybe I'll send her to look for Triss when we get back. Triss will listen to her.
:{{DIcon}} Why?
:'''Melissa:''' Eh, how do I put it... She has some kind of aura that inexplicably makes people respect her.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} I see.
:{{DIcon}} Oh? Tell me more.
::'''Melissa:''' You know how I found out?
::'''Melissa:''' When we were younger, she once stopped a large brawl between kids.
::'''Melissa:''' Even though I'm older than her, I couldn't take charge of the situation. Maybe the adults thought it wasn't a big deal, but I saw the aura in her eyes.
::'''Melissa:''' Her powerful and pervasive presence compelled many to follow her lead.
::'''Melissa:''' When I heard her say she wanted to be a conductor, I wasn't surprised at all. Controlling an orchestra wouldn't be very difficult for her.
{{Dialogue End}}
